puzzle.hint: An attribute of Allah meaning 'Magnificent' or 'Mighty'.
puzzle.arabicVerse: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
puzzle.verse: 42:4 - To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
